description: a cylinder of radius R 2 about z from 0 to 2 with its second quadrant (x < 0, y > 0) cut down to z 1, the low quarter's rim, an arc of a quarter turn, filleted at r 0.3: a plane against a cylinder along an open arc whose two ends each run into a step, a plane through the axis rising from the rim's end, a mixed corner (the cylinder's vertical edge on the step convex, the step's foot concave). At each end the vertical edge is lengthened down the cylinder past the vertex to the side contact, the foot is cut at the top contact, and the step takes the blend's section from outside (ADR-0038); the blend is a quarter of a ring torus of major radius R − r, minor r, with no end effect past the planes. The volume is 7π less the corner's section (1 − π/4) r² swept a quarter turn about the axis at R − r (10 − 3π) / (12 − 3π) by Pappus; the area 15π + 4 less the top's quarter annulus and the side's band, plus the torus's quarter and the two sections the steps gain
